archetypes.name: delta-scope
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 commits now depend on snapshot-derived pathspec boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 lint-fix and commit-fixes pathspec flow. Focus on whether pre-existing dirty or staged hunks can still be swept into commits, especially across dirty-baseline lint fixes and --stage-all handoff commits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ci-selfheal
archetypes.rationale: The CI fixer now mutates harness files before delegation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the narrow mechanical CI self-heal path. Check that only the intended legacy-prefix and cleanup partition signatures edit files, that mixed failures rollback before delegation, and that unrelated failures still use the existing delegated fixer path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
